sonnet.problem: The fill-in-the-blank answer 'high places' was already shown on story card 2 ('The people are still sacrificing on the high places') and in the question of card 3. The baker can fill the blank by copying a word from an earlier card, and the card re-asks a fact already told.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
